info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Validation Management API
info.description: The Financial Instrument Validation Management API enables businesses to manage and validate financial instrument reference data efficiently. This API allows users to submit validation requests for market data related to various financial instruments, ensuring compliance and accuracy in financial operations. Typical consumers include financial institutions, traders, and risk management teams seeking to maintain high-quality reference data. By utilizing this API, organizations can automate the validation process, enhancing the reliability of their financial data assets.

post.summary: Create Validation for a Financial Instrument
post.description: This endpoint initiates the creation of validation data for the specified financial instrument. It allows users to submit validation criteria and requirements, ensuring the integrity and compliance of financial data within the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate the financial instrument reference data for the specified identifier. It requires the necessary attributes and parameters to be validated in accordance with the business rules defined for the instrument.
